title: Reproducibility package: unsafe-side decision errors in infrastructure robustness screening
description: Code, configuration, derived tables, generated figures and provenance records for the revised study of analytical percolation thresholds used as infrastructure robustness screens. The package contains the finite-network estimator with exact endpoint evaluation, finite degree-preserving controls, the external city-holdout evaluation, response-definition checks, control ladders and figure/table builders. Raw third-party source archives are not redistributed; retrieval locations, versions and use conditions are recorded in DATASETS_AND_LINKS.csv, and the non-sensitive derived outputs needed to regenerate the reported tables and figures are included.
